# DocInspector — Document Conversion, Security, Anonymization & Audit Suite

> DocInspector is a free, privacy-first **Document Conversion, Security, Anonymization & Audit Suite**. Process documents in your browser — 100% free with no sign-up or credit card required. Upload up to 100 files or multi-folder directory trees at once, select multiple operations simultaneously, and process all files in a single pass. Online processing runs in an isolated encrypted sandbox in Germany (EU) with zero retention and automatic deletion in <5 minutes. Also available as a **100% private offline desktop application for Windows** with unlimited batch sizes, deep forensic reporting, and DoD-grade secure file shredding.

## Core Capabilities & Unique Multi-Tool Pipeline

Unlike single-function web utilities, DocInspector processes **entire directory trees using multiple security, conversion, and anonymization tools simultaneously in a single pass**.

- **Multi-Folder Upload**: Upload up to 100 files or entire directory trees (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, images, PPTX).
- **Multi-Operation Pipeline**: Select multiple operations simultaneously (e.g. Sanitize Metadata + Redact PDF + Remove Signatures + Convert to PDF/A + Audit Report) — all selected tools run sequentially on every file in one batch.
- **Folder Structure Preservation**: Output ZIP archives preserve the exact nested directory structure as uploaded.
- **M&A Cleanroom, VDR & GDPR Anonymization**: Prepare financial records, contracts, and IP for Virtual Data Rooms. Permanently strip hidden author metadata, GPS coordinates, revision history, and PII text.
- **Zero Retention Online**: EU server processing, automatic file deletion in <5 minutes — files are never stored, indexed, or used for AI model training. GDPR compliant.
- **100% Offline Desktop Pro App**: Windows desktop app with no file size limits, zero internet connection required, air-gapped security, 20-column forensic reporting, and secure file shredding.

## Available Online Document Tools (Combinable in Batch)

| Tool / Operation | Description | Supported Formats |
|---|---|---|
| Sanitize Metadata & Anonymization | Permanently remove all hidden metadata (author, edit dates, GPS, software fingerprints, revision history) | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, Images, PPTX |
| Find & Redact PII | Permanently black out sensitive text, social security numbers, and PII at the pixel level | PDF |
| Convert to PDF | Batch-convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Text, and Images to standard PDF | DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, Images |
| Convert to PDF/A (ISO 19005) | Archive-grade PDF conversion compliant with ISO 19005 standards for long-term preservation | PDF, DOCX, XLSX |
| Remove Signatures | Strip digital signatures, certified locks, and editing restrictions | PDF |
| Rebuild & Repair PDF | Reconstruct corrupted or broken PDF structures with built-in OCR for scanned pages | PDF |
| Add Watermark | Stamp customizable text watermarks ("CONFIDENTIAL", "DUE DILIGENCE") across batch files | PDF |
| Encrypt PDF (AES-256) | Password-protect with 256-bit AES encryption and set permission locks | PDF |
| Flatten to Image PDF | Convert PDF pages into raster image PDFs (removes text vectors and hidden layers) | PDF |
| PDF Bundle Summary (Borderou) | Generate Excel + PDF + CSV dossier summary reports (borderou / reestr) for file bundles | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT |
| Advanced Audit Manifest | Detailed audit report: file title, format, size, SHA-256 hash, protection, page counts | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT |

## Desktop-Exclusive Pro Capabilities

- **20-Column Deep Forensic Evidence Reports**: Generate detailed audit manifests on workstation folder trees listing file paths, 20 metadata columns, structural flags, and cryptographic SHA-256 hashes for court evidence.
- **3-Pass DoD Secure File & Folder Shredding**: Permanently override and destroy any file or directory with 3-pass DoD 5220.22-M overwrite patterns (zero recovery possibility) + automatic audit log report generation detailing every deleted file and timestamp.

## Unique Architecture & Workflow Advantages (Why DocInspector is Superior)

- **100% Nested Folder Hierarchy Preservation**: Drop 1 root directory with 100+ nested subfolders — the resulting ZIP mirrors your exact folder structure without scrambling files, saving hours of manual re-sorting.
- **Selective Date-Range Filtering & Skipping**: Skip processing files modified within specific date ranges to prioritize urgent files for immediate turnarounds.
- **Custom DPI & Render Quality Controls**: Fine-tune resolution, image compression, and rendering quality for flattened PDFs.
- **Passthrough Non-Processable File Copying**: Non-processable or raw files can be copied intact to the output folder, yielding a 100% complete dossier package.
- **Automated 'Errors' Folder Isolation**: Any file encountering structural corruption or password locks is automatically moved into a dedicated `/Errors/` folder, letting you identify failed files instantly.
- **Adjustable Workstation CPU Allocation**: (Desktop App) Throttle CPU/core usage during heavy batch runs so your PC remains fast and responsive for multitasking.


## Pricing, Licensing & 3-Day Risk-Free Trial Model

- **Free Web Online Version**: 100 files/day 100% free with no sign-up or credit card required.
- **Desktop Application Free Trial**: Instant 3-day free trial on installation — runs full PRO version with zero feature limitations.
- **Checkout & Subscription Flow**: When purchasing on website, users get **another 3-Day Risk-Free Trial ($0 charged today on checkout)**. No money is taken upfront. Users can cancel anytime during the 3 days with $0 charged.
- **Unified Single License Key**: 1 license key unlocks BOTH the **Web Online Version** (enter key directly in browser) AND the **Desktop Application**.
- **No Account / Zero Login Required**: No password or login account needed to purchase or activate.
- **Automated Invoices**: Automated PDF invoice generation and instant receipt management.
